create_edgetam_video_model: create an EdgeTamVideoModel instance with EdgeTamVideoConfig for video object segmentation
run_video_object_segmentation: run video object segmentation on frames with point and mask prompts via EdgeTamVideoModel.forward
encode_new_memory: encode predicted masks into memory features for conditioning future frames in video tracking
prepare_memory_conditioned_features: fuse current frame vision features with memory from previous frames for object tracking
build_perceiver_resampler: build a spatial perceiver resampler that downsamples vision features into 1D and 2D latent tokens
